fresh_seed_derivation.rule: for i=0,1,... compute SHA256('chronotrace-v2-confirmation-seed:' + decimal i), interpret the first 4 digest bytes as an unsigned big-endian uint32, skip any collision with a spent or already-selected seed, and take the first four accepted values

target_history_selection_rule: the four cyclic A/B/C/D orders and their reverses; same eight targets for every seed; every stage appears exactly twice in every position

execution_sharing.unit: one fresh seed per parallel job in one immutable workflow run

certificate.label_blind_rule: solve both precedence orientation classes for each unordered pair before consulting the generating target history
certificate.class_exclusion_rule: orientation class impossible iff proof-safe corrected Euclidean lower bound exceeds 1e-6
certificate.pair_inference_rule: exactly one excluded implies opposite orientation; neither excluded implies abstention; both excluded implies invalidity
certificate.full_history_rule: full history certified only if all six inferred pair orientations form one transitive total order
certificate.evaluation_rule: compare inferred relations/history to the generating target only after all pair decisions are fixed
certificate.terminal_exactness_sanity: at K=N=4 each orientation-class local-order LP primal matches an independent complete-permutation convex-hull witness-space LP within 1e-8
certificate.euclidean_soundness_sanity: each proof-safe lower bound is no larger than the direct exact Euclidean vertex-class distance beyond 1e-8

required_validity_checks: fresh seed equals one of the four deterministically derived values and is disjoint from all spent seeds
source methodology/model/numerical settings match frozen locks
streaming exact K3 basis uses 40 stage executions and caches all 24 exact degree-three prefixes
all eight target endpoints are replayed before K4 and all 32 target-specific witnesses are frozen after exactly 72 stage executions
each target active lift reproduces its independently replayed target endpoint hash
every scalar K4 Mobius reconstruction matches its directly projected endpoint within 1e-8 absolute/relative tolerance
each seed uses exactly 96 stage executions
both orientation classes are solved for all six pairs without target-label access in the decision function
each K=N orientation-class local-order primal matches the independent complete-permutation convex-hull benchmark within 1e-8
every proof-safe lower bound is sound against the direct exact Euclidean vertex-class distance
no inferred pair contradicts the generating history
no full K4 model-space tensors are retained

outcome_classification.excellent: at least 28 of 32 full histories certified correctly with zero invalid cases
outcome_classification.strong: 24 to 27 of 32 full histories certified correctly with zero invalid cases
outcome_classification.partial: 16 to 23 of 32 full histories certified correctly with zero invalid cases
outcome_classification.scientific_negative: 15 or fewer of 32 full histories certified correctly with zero invalid cases
outcome_classification.invalid: any provenance/replay/freeze/terminal-exactness/certificate-soundness failure, any inferred pair contradiction, or both orientations excluded for any pair

reporting_rule: report all 32 fresh cases and all 192 pair decisions; do not drop abstentions, failures, or seeds
scope_limitation: N=4,K=4 terminal exactness only; no claim of universal exact fixed-K certification for N>K
